batch: P6 / T17 — single-chat demand cards, one authorization and original task card

environment.type: jsdom frontend integration harness with real Vue Router and full App; HTTP doubles and fake timers only
environment.network: stubbed; no provider or image call

scope: the requirement card and the task card render inside the same single-column chat stream instead of a separate permanent workflow column
the server task_state constraints are split into hard requirements and soft preferences with the same labels and values
the requirement card is keyed by its artifact id and revision, while the delivery card is keyed by the stable delivery id
an approved current card exposes exactly one primary confirmation entry only while the card is still pending
an already confirmed card and repeated polling of the same business facts do not add a second confirmation card, task card or primary button
the task card consumes the server safe reason and progress instead of repeating the legacy current-question heading
the card flow performs no message, workflow action, confirmation or model write
inputs: WorkflowView with an approved final_brief artifact, pending requirements_card state, confirm_requirements action and server task_state
task_state constraints: hard texts 图片文字=春季新品; soft style_keywords 风格关键词=简洁/暖色
a second identical workflow response after manual refresh
a task_state carrying a safe missing-information reason 请补充品牌授权信息后再生成。
an already confirmed requirements_card approval for the same artifact digest
commands: cd .worktrees/t103 && D:/Desktop/新建文件夹/node_modules/.bin/vitest.cmd run --config vitest.config.ts tests/t103-single-chat-cards.spec.ts

calls.note: All T17 tests assert zero non-GET writes; only project detail and workflow status reads occur through the HTTP double.

acceptance.FE3-AC-02: pass — the chat page renders one conversation/workflow message stream in a single column; the requirement card, task card and delivery entry are in that stream rather than a permanent right-hand workflow column
acceptance.FE3-AC-03: pass — only the current approved, still-pending requirement card exposes the single primary confirmation button; an already confirmed card exposes none and no unapproved candidate body is rendered by the card
acceptance.FE3-AC-04: pass with inherited coverage — T74/T13 and the backend T08 atomic-acceptance suites remain green in the same full run; T17 adds no second acceptance path and polling adds no write
acceptance.FE3-AC-13: pass for the task card — it displays the server safe reason, progress phase/stage and actions, with no fake percentage, automatic retry or unsupported cancel control
acceptance.FE3-AC-15: pass with inherited coverage — task-card reason text is server-projected; existing T68/T69 recovery/action suites remain green and confirm buttons come only from server available_actions
acceptance.WG3-AC-10: partial — rendered safe reason/progress/strength projection passes in jsdom; real browser/provider observation remains release scope

ticket_items.1_cards_in_one_message_stream: pass — requirement and task cards render within ChatPage .chat-stream; no separate permanent workflow column
ticket_items.2_card_identity: pass — confirmation card carries artifact id/revision; delivery card carries the stable delivery id; duplicate polling does not duplicate cards
ticket_items.3_only_current_valid_card_enables_confir: pass — pending approved card shows one 确认以上需求并生成图片 button; confirmed card shows none
ticket_items.4_one_atomic_acceptance: pass with inherited coverage — no new write path; T74/T13 and backend atomic acceptance suites stay green
ticket_items.5_task_card_safe_state: pass — safe reason, phase, stage label, awaiting-user marker and server action list are used; legacy 当前问题与下一步 heading is suppressed when task_state exists
ticket_items.6_no_hardening_or_candidate_leak: pass with inherited coverage — soft constraints stay under 偏好, hard under 必须满足; candidate prompt/artifact bodies are not projected into the card
ticket_items.7_known_information_not_reasked: pass with inherited coverage — existing T73 clarification and T03 conversation suites remain green
